actionable_fixes: In _compute_kernel method (around line 190-200), reorder the checks: move the surjective FpGroup check BEFORE the infinity check. Current order: infinity check first (raises NotImplementedError), then surjective FpGroup check. Required order: surjective FpGroup check first, then infinity check. This allows _surjective_fp_kernel to handle surjective homomorphisms between FpGroups regardless of whether the groups are finite or infinite.
